chip.description: MMU providing a 23-bit virtual address space to a pair of M6809 CPUs in eight 8 KB banks each, and emitting the RAM/ROM/video chip-enable lines; also serves as the interrupt controller for the two 6809s and as the system reset generator.
chip.notes: src/mame/namco/c117.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "Namco C117 MMU". Filed memory (taxonomy Q8) because address translation and banking is the part's stated primary function; the interrupt and reset duties are secondary, so TB5 does not fire.
